name: How do I choose the right contractor for my ADU or garage conversion project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my ADU or garage conversion project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor is crucial for a successful ADU or garage conversion project. Look for a licensed and insured contractor with specific experience in ADUs and local building codes. Review their portfolio, check references, and ensure transparent communication regarding timelines, budgets, and change orders. A reputable contractor will provide detailed proposals, adhere to schedules, and maintain high-quality craftsmanship, ensuring your project meets your expectations and complies with all regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed and insured contractor with ADU experience, review their portfolio and references, and ensure clear communication and transparent proposals.
